scientific_question: In a second taxon on the same frozen 19-island geography, is exact occupied-source topology most informative for realized presences when finite-source configuration sensitivity is high?

evidence_class.response_status: bird species matrix unopened by Structural at freeze

frozen_geography.reuse_reason: geometry and split were frozen response-independently before any boreal bird matrix value was opened

matched_topology_null.edge_length_bin_rule: Hyndman-Fan type-7 q20/q40/q60/q80 of the 35 actual edge lengths
matched_topology_null.kernel_scale_rule: reuse the frozen actual-topology kernel scale for every null; only adjacency changes

configuration_sensitivity.target_weight: exp(-actual graph shortest-path distance / frozen kernel scale)
configuration_sensitivity.H_i: population variance of the six possible-source weights divided by squared mean weight

response_free_geometry_audit.interpretation: on this geometry occupancy count n is expected to dominate S variation because most confirmatory targets have similarly high H_i

pilot_access_rule.future_one_shot_surface: six frozen pilot islands x all 54 frozen bird species only
pilot_access_rule.species_eligibility_after_pilot: retain species with 1-4 occupied pilot islands; zero-presence and 5-6-presence species are excluded
pilot_access_rule.if_gate_fails: STOP bird route without opening any confirmatory bird response

reference_and_candidate.C_null_add: same two graph-path features recomputed separately on each of the 20 frozen null topologies
reference_and_candidate.fit: pooled ridge logistic regression, lambda=1, deterministic solver inherited from the completed boreal 19-island pipeline

primary_test.weight: S_i(n_s), computed only from frozen geography plus pilot occupancy count n_s
primary_test.within_block_weighting: normalize positive S weights to sum to one within each estimable confirmatory block
primary_test.P1: equal-block mean of S-weighted [binary logloss(C_actual)-binary logloss(R3)]
primary_test.P2: equal-block mean of S-weighted [binary logloss(C_actual)-mean binary logloss(C_null_1..20)]
support_requires: P1 point estimate < 0 and 95% spatial-block bootstrap upper bound < 0
P2 point estimate < 0 and 95% spatial-block bootstrap upper bound < 0
primary_test.if_presence_gate_fails: terminal non-estimable; do not alter species threshold, S definition, or endpoint

claim_boundary.can_support: same-geography cross-taxon prospective replication of occupancy-regime topology specificity

next_action: freeze and verify the exact 20-null topology ensemble plus response-free H_i surface; only after those objects are committed may a separate one-shot bird-pilot authorization be constructed
